links.outcome: Addiction medicine consultation rate (primary) and 30-day readmissions (secondary), pre vs post AI screener
links.effect: Consultations unchanged (1.35% vs 1.51%, P<0.001 for non-inferiority); 30-day readmissions reduced (OR 0.53, 95% CI 0.30-0.91, P=0.02); US$6,801 per readmission avoided.
links.quote: In secondary outcome analysis, the AI screener was associated with a reduction in 30-day readmissions (odds ratio: 0.53, 95% confidence interval: 0.30-0.91, P = 0.02) with an incremental cost of US$6,801 per readmission avoided, demonstrating its potential as a scalable, cost-effective solution for OUD care.

screen.reason: The study evaluates the real-world clinical implementation and outcomes of deploying an EHR-integrated AI screener for opioid use disorder versus usual care.
